rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Beneficiary Change Velocity Anomaly")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct beneficiary_id) by account_id > 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:core_banking (event_type="BENEFICIARY_ADD" OR event_type="BENEFICIARY_MODIFY" OR event_type="BENEFICIARY_DELETE")
| stats dc(beneficiary_id) as unique_beneficiary_id by account_id
| where unique_beneficiary_id > 3
rules.title: DL-0019: Beneficiary Change Velocity Anomaly (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for MFA Method Switch Before High-Value Transaction")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_mfa_change | near selection_high_value_txn by account_id")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:identity_management
event_type="MFA_METHOD_CHANGE"
(new_mfa_method="sms_otp" OR new_mfa_method="email_otp" OR new_mfa_method="voice_call")
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT")
transaction_amount>=5000
| transaction account_id maxspan=4h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0021: MFA Method Switch Before High-Value Transaction (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Wire Beneficiary Name Mismatch
status: experimental
description: Detects when the wire beneficiary name provided by the originator does not match the account holder name at the receiving institution. Name mismatches on wire transfers are a strong indicator of payme
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wire_system
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "WIRE_INITIATION"
        beneficiary_name_match: false
        transaction_amount|gte: 1000
    filter_known_dba:
        beneficiary_account_type: "DBA"
    condition: selection and not filter_known_dba
level: high
rules.title: DL-0024: Wire Beneficiary Name Mismatch (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Power of Attorney or Authorized Signer Change
status: experimental
description: Detects changes to power of attorney designations or authorized signers on commercial and business accounts. Fraudsters may socially engineer or forge POA documents to gain control of business account
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: core_banking
detection:
    selection:
        event_type:
            - "POA_ADD"
            - "POA_MODIFY"
            - "AUTHORIZED_SIGNER_ADD"
            - "AUTHORIZED_SIGNER_MODIFY"
        account_type:
            - "commercial"
            - "business"
            - "corporate"
            - "trust"
    selection_high_value:
        account_balance|gte: 50000
    condition: selection and selection_high_value
level: high
rules.title: DL-0025: Power of Attorney or Authorized Signer Change (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: First-Time International Wire to New Country
status: experimental
description: Detects international wire transfers sent to a country that has no prior transaction history for the originating account. First-time international wires, especially to high-risk corridors, are a key i
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wire_system
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "WIRE_INITIATION"
        wire_type: "international"
        beneficiary_country_first_time: true
        transaction_amount|gte: 5000
    filter_known_correspondent:
        beneficiary_bank_relationship: "established"
    condition: selection and not filter_known_correspondent
level: high
rules.title: DL-0027: First-Time International Wire to New Country (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Split Transfer Chain Detection")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_large_inbound | near selection_multiple_outbound by account_id | count(distinct beneficiary_id) by account_id > 2")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:wire_system
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=25000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER")
transaction_amount<10000
| stats dc(beneficiary_id) as unique_beneficiary_id by account_id
| where unique_beneficiary_id > 2
rules.title: DL-0029: Split Transfer Chain Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: After-Hours Wire Transfer Initiation
status: experimental
description: Detects wire transfers initiated outside the account's established normal business hours. Attackers often execute unauthorized wires during evenings, weekends, or holidays when fraud detection staff a
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wire_system
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "WIRE_INITIATION"
        transaction_amount|gte: 5000
        initiated_outside_business_hours: true
    selection_channel:
        channel:
            - "online_banking"
            - "mobile_app"
            - "api"
    filter_pre_authorized:
        wire_status: "pre_authorized_recurring"
    condition: selection and selection_channel and not filter_pre_authorized
level: high
rules.title: DL-0030: After-Hours Wire Transfer Initiation (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Rapid Outbound Wire After Large Inbound")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection_inbound | near selection_outbound by account_id")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_CREDIT" OR event_type="ACH_CREDIT")
transaction_amount>=10000
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_DEBIT")
transaction_amount>=8000
| transaction account_id maxspan=6h
| where eventcount >= 2
rules.title: DL-0031: Rapid Outbound Wire After Large Inbound (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Beneficiary Country Mismatch with Business Profile
status: experimental
description: Detects wire transfers to countries where the account holder has no established business relationship or prior transaction history. Combined with other indicators, this can reveal business email compr
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wire_system
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "WIRE_INITIATION"
        wire_type: "international"
        beneficiary_country_in_business_profile: false
        transaction_amount|gte: 5000
    filter_consumer_remittance:
        account_type: "personal"
        transaction_amount|lt: 3000
    condition: selection and not filter_consumer_remittance
level: high
rules.title: DL-0032: Beneficiary Country Mismatch with Business Profile (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Round-Dollar Wire Amount Pattern")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count() by account_id > 4")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:wire_system
event_type="WIRE_INITIATION"
transaction_amount>=1000
transaction_amount_is_round=true
| stats count as event_count by account_id
| where event_count > 4
rules.title: DL-0033: Round-Dollar Wire Amount Pattern (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
title: Wire to FATF High-Risk Jurisdiction
status: experimental
description: Detects wire transfers to jurisdictions on the FATF high-risk or increased monitoring lists. While not inherently fraudulent, wires to these jurisdictions combined with other risk factors (new benefic
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wire_system
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "WIRE_INITIATION"
        wire_type: "international"
        beneficiary_country:
            - "MM"
            - "KP"
            - "IR"
            - "YE"
            - "SY"
            - "HT"
            - "VU"
            - "PH"
            - "NG"
            - "SS"
        transaction_amount|gte: 1000
    filter_established_relationship:
        beneficiary_relationship_days|gte: 365
        prior_transaction_count|gte: 10
    condition: selection and not filter_established_relationship
level: high
rules.title: DL-0035: Wire to FATF High-Risk Jurisdiction (Sigma)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Payment Instruction Velocity Spike")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count() by session_id > 5")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
(event_type="WIRE_INITIATION" OR event_type="ACH_BATCH_SUBMIT" OR event_type="INTERNAL_TRANSFER" OR event_type="PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION")
aggregate="sum(transaction_amount) by account_id"
threshold_multiplier="3.0"
| stats count as event_count by session_id
| where event_count > 5
rules.title: DL-0036: Payment Instruction Velocity Spike (SPLUNK)
